# ObMap System Documentation Index (for LLMs & Coding Agents)

> Visual Knowledge Operating System & High-Signal Social Knowledge Network combining Obsidian (local-first `.md` + `@obmap/sdk`), XMind (deterministic Canvas2D solvers), Notion (RBAC + derived views), Wikipedia (`/explore` open index), and LinkedIn × ResearchGate × GitHub (`/:username` profile, citations, Fork & Merge Request).

## Essential Constitution & Entrypoints
- [Repository Rules & Guidelines (AGENTS.md)](AGENTS.md): Stack, 13 target domains (`community` replacing `public-reader` + `dashboard`), 11 Mandatory Architectural Rules (Rule 11 = Changelog Sync).
- [Documentation Portal](docs/README.md): Role-based reading paths and full directory map.
- [Navigation Summary](docs/SUMMARY.md): Compact topic tree across all folders.
- [Master Blueprint v2.0](docs/00-meta/00-0-master-blueprint.md): Authoritative product, UX, routing, RBAC, dynamic monetization (`Xendit/Midtrans` first), and extensibility architecture.
- [Quo Vadis v2.0](docs/00-meta/00-2-quovadis.md): 20-dimension readiness audit, 3-Stage Progressive Shipping Gate, `EPIC-01`–`15`, and §6 Locked Architectural Decisions.
- [Step-by-Step Execution Playbook](docs/02-planning/README.md): Ordered agent execution queue (`STEP-01.1` through `STEP-05.4`) with prerequisites and verification gates.

## Modular Changelog System (Read Last 15 Lines First)
- [Machine Changelog Stream (JSONL)](docs/_machine/changelog.jsonl): Append-only JSON Lines stream (token-efficient recent context).
- [Modular Changelog Hub](docs/changelogs/README.md): Rolling Top-10 summary and mandatory 3-step update SOP.
- [Monthly Changelog (2026-11)](docs/changelogs/2026-11.md): Structured entries (`CHG-YYYYMMDD-NNN`).
- [Archive Wave 1-3](docs/changelogs/archive-wave-1-to-3.md): Historical Wave 1–3 summary.

# AGENT OPERATING DIRECTIVE
1. Read `AGENTS.md`, `tail -n 15 docs/_machine/changelog.jsonl`, and `docs/02-planning/README.md` before coding to pick the next `[NEXT]`/`[PLANNED]` step (`STEP-01.1`..`05.4`).
2. Enforce all 8 locked decisions (`community` refactor, `/p/*` hard cutover without redirect, Stage 2 individual `/admin` user approval, dynamic DB quotas/pricing in `/admin`, Xendit/Midtrans first, manual Verified Scholar curation, default `CC BY-SA 4.0`, Headless Controller `<= 300` lines).
3. Before ending ANY task touching code, SQL, config, or architecture docs, update `docs/02-planning/README.md` status (if applicable) and perform all 3 atomic changelog updates required by `AGENTS.md` Rule 11 (`docs/_machine/changelog.jsonl`, `docs/changelogs/YYYY-MM.md`, `docs/changelogs/README.md`).
